column1: # Two-light halts only. Aaron, 2026-08-22. `Side Awarded` is who the referee
# gave the action to, i.e. who held PRIORITY -- not necessarily who scored:
# on a mixed halt an off-target hit by the priority holder annuls and nothing
# is awarded. Single-light halts are absent by design, so Score JUMPS between
# rows and is NOT a checksum here.
